youtube_description:
38 minutes of gentle winter cartoon stories and sing-along songs for toddlers and preschoolers (ages 2–6), with Pip Puppy, Lulu Lamb, Mimi Kitten, Honey Bunny, Dotty Duckling and Ollie Owl. From a snowy morning in the park all the way to a cosy sleepover bedtime. Short new host scenes between stories invite little ones to answer and join in. Every spoken line has captions.

What's inside (and what your child practises):
☃️ Pip Puppy's First Snow Day – guessing animal footprints, big and small snowballs, counting, and hopping, stomping and waddling to the Snow Day Song.
❄️ Five Little Snowflakes with Pip Puppy – counting down from five, warm and cold, fast and slow, and why snowflakes melt on a warm nose.
🌨️ Lulu Lamb's First Snowflakes – naming bright colours, counting snowflakes and their six arms, twirling like a snowflake and a calm snowy breath.
🧤 Lulu Lamb's Mitten Song – a getting-dressed routine (hat, scarf, mittens, boots), colours and counting ten warm fingers.
🧣 Pip Puppy's Warm Coat Hunt – how animals stay warm (wool, feathers, fur), thick and thin, and counting puffy birds.
🌟 Five Little Stars with Ollie Owl and Pip Puppy – being patient, counting stars as they come out, star colours and shapes, and a gentle counting lullaby.
🧦 Pip Puppy and Mimi's Warm Socks Bedtime – matching pairs, a sock colour game, counting to three and slow bedtime breaths.

The last two stories are calm and sleepy, so this also works as a wind-down before nap or bedtime.

💛 Share with a parent who'd love some cosy, snowy story time today!
